summary: Lincoln County, MT, Kootenai NF: tower listed under 1934, abandoned 1948 per firelookout.com; both lists mark it gone. No description of the site today found.

facts.status_note: Abandoned 1948 and marked gone by firelookout.com and the FFLA list; no source describes what remains today

events.note: firelookout.com gives only '1934: tower'; builder and design not stated

evidence.supports: Kootenai National Forest as the agency
tower listed under 1934, abandoned 1948, now gone
FFLA lists Eureka Hill, Lincoln, as a tower and gone

notes_for_editor: Both sources are firelookout.com and the FFLA list; the FFLA list only repeats 'Tower Gone'. Two web searches found no independent record of a Eureka Hill lookout, so the 1934 and 1948 dates are single-source. The record's coordinates were not checked against the 'two miles south of Eureka' description. No access source found, so facts.access is omitted. Record kind 'tower' and status 'gone' agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
